description:
[Trading Data API] Transaction count (nonce) for an address or ENS name: confirmed nonce plus pending nonce, so an agent can sign the next transaction without a collision.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-nonce?address=0xB71C06dAC44c91bc997FB84C247DeEF676F4A9f6&chain=base`

Use when you need an address's confirmed and pending transaction count before building a transaction. Not for balances.

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

address.description: Required. A 0x address or an ENS name.

chain.description: Optional. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default base).

name: chain_nonce
